title: Guard MSVC MANIFESTDEPENDENCY flag to msvc target and re-align cvh-dev/copilot scope strictly to project config specialist
commitMessage: fix(agent): enforce CVH_DEV_TOOLS on copilot role as defense-in-depth
author: Lead Systems Engineer (tauri-rust-engineer) & Lead UI Artisan (react-tailwind-artisan)
summary: Resolved MinGW (GNU) linker compilation failures and rectified scope drift across CVH-DEV and Copilot agents. 1. Guarded the MSVC-specific /MANIFESTDEPENDENCY flag in src-tauri/build.rs behind (target_os == "windows" && target_env == "msvc"), eliminating unrecognized linker flag errors on x86_64-pc-windows-gnu toolchains. 2. Re-aligned CVH-DEV and Copilot strictly to Project Configuration Specialists (.cvh/ environment, boards, pipelines, agent personas, rules, and hooks): stripped create_task, create_tasks, and complete_task from their allowed tool suites, enforced the 7-tool whitelist CVH_DEV_TOOLS (["read_file", "write_file", "edit_file", "glob", "grep", "execute_command", "web_search"]) across prompt compilation, candidate tool filtering (active_tools.retain), and runtime tool execution gatekeeping (execute_tool) for both cvh-dev and copilot roles. 3. Re-aligned CopilotDock.tsx UI from 'АРХИТЕКТОР' (feature planning/task creation) to 'НАСТРОЙКА ПРОЕКТА' with updated placeholders and empty state text ('Спросить о настройке досок, пайплайнов, правил или персон проекта...'). 4. Added Rust unit tests test_cvh_dev_cannot_create_or_complete_tasks and test_copilot_tool_suite_has_seven_tools.

verification.l2Review: APPROVED_WITH_CAVEATS by agent-developer-reviewer (caveat: defense-in-depth copilot role execution check resolved in 22fa9f4)

caveatsResolved: Defense-in-depth: extended runtime execute_tool whitelist check from role == 'cvh-dev' to (role == 'cvh-dev' || role == 'copilot') to guarantee copilot cannot invoke unlisted tools if called directly.
